instruction: I have difficulty using a physical keyboard. Open the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and leave it available for me. Save every walk title in the provided PDF snapshot of the NSW National Parks webpage that is Grade 1 with a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less to `answer.txt` on the Desktop, one title per line in walking-track listing order.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open.
Review the PDF snapshot of the NSW National Parks access-friendly walking tracks webpage already open in Chrome.
Check the listed time and grade information for the walking tracks.
Find every walk that is Grade 1 and has a maximum listed walking time of 45 minutes or less.

Enter `Fairfax Heritage walking track`, `Jennifer Street boardwalk`, `Three Sisters walk`, `Bungoona lookout and path`, `Palm Valley Currenbah walking track`, `Victoria Park boardwalk`, `Devils Hole lookout walk and picnic area`, `Point lookout walking track`, `Rainforest walking track`, and `Whitegum lookout walking track`, one per line in that order.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$file='C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\answer.txt'; if (!(Test-Path $file)) { Write-Output 'ANSWER_INCORRECT'; exit }; $actual=@(Get-Content $file | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }); $expected=@('Fairfax Heritage walking track','Jennifer Street boardwalk','Three Sisters walk','Bungoona lookout and path','Palm Valley Currenbah walking track','Victoria Park boardwalk','Devils Hole lookout walk and picnic area','Point lookout walking track','Rainforest walking track','Whitegum lookout walking track'); $ok=($actual.Count -eq $expected.Count); if($ok) { for($i=0; $i -lt $expected.Count; $i++) { if($actual[$i] -cne $expected[$i]) { $ok=$false; break } } }; if($ok) { Write-Output 'ANSWER_CORRECT' } else { Write-Output 'ANSWER_INCORRECT' }"
